 # fixture repo
+
+## Running the tests
+
+Tests are written with [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/). Install it and run the
+suite from the repository root:
+
+```sh
+pip install pytest
+pytest
+```
+
+To run a single file or a single test:
+
+```sh
+pytest test_pricing_cache.py
+pytest test_pricing_cache.py::test_falls_back_to_snapshot
+```
+
+Add `-v` for per-test output and `-x` to stop at the first failure.
